why: Cloud Try another approach (#34581): the fork sequence and its result contract live in CmuxNextCloud (CloudTryAnotherApproach); the App keeps only the adapters that need App-only types: locating the chat through AppServices.locateTab and services.machines, FeedService.apiBaseURL for the owner API, the child daemon's store wait, AgentTabStore.registryHost and agentTabs.open for the child tab, plus the AgentTabStore callback and its sign-in wiring. It moves with the Cloud folder's destination row (architecture-refactor-DESIGN.md section 4).
